experiment: InTaSet aligned to external motor sparse-state horizons and calibration budgets

task_contract.target_input_availability: full recorded future pump path is conditionally supplied; this is not an online command-availability claim
task_contract.directional_split: M1->M2 and M2->M1, with the target test trace held out from fitting and calibration
task_contract.baseline_and_offline_tasks: endpoint interpolation remains offline; teacher-forced one-step metrics remain diagnostics; neither is mixed with causal sparse rollouts
task_contract.calibration: source model weights frozen; linear and discrete sparse methods use per-state delta gains; neural/grey-box models use per-state vector-field rate gains

interpretation: This run aligns time horizons and observed target-data budgets across datasets; it does not remove the recorded-future-input limitation or make water and motor raw errors directly comparable.
